description: Franka FR3 grips soft block A at mid height, squeezes its measured width into the 30-40 % band under a closed-loop rule shared by all platforms, lifts 120 mm, holds 2 s, carries it to the target area, lowers it to just above the table, opens, retreats and observes 2 s.
units: m, kg, s; Z up, X towards the worktop, Y to the robot's left

platform_solvers.dexsim: DexUniSolverCfg(contact_mode='full', coupling='two_way'): MuJoCo owns the Franka; VBD owns the soft block and static shapes; per-vertex particle-shape contact
platform_solvers.embodichain: EmbodiChain SimulationManager, NewtonPhysicsCfg(solver='dexuni') with the same DexUni options as the DexSim script
platform_solvers.isaaclab: Newton CouplerProxy: MuJoCo-Warp entry owns the Franka; VBD entry owns the soft block and static shapes; every robot link proxied into VBD; per-vertex particle contact

robot.model_note: Newton-assets FR3 arm + Franka Hand (franka_hand_white); same asset, drives and limits as S01-T
robot.finger_mimic: both finger joints are driven independently with identical targets on all platforms
robot.gravity: robot links do not feel gravity (DexSim gravity compensation 1.0 / IsaacLab disable_gravity)
robot.finger_note: fingers start open at q=0.039 (pad gap 78 mm around the 60 mm block plus 2 x 2 mm particle radius: 7 mm per side) and close along world Y during the squeeze phase

soft_block.tet_split: Kuhn 6 tets per hexahedral cell (shared main diagonal)
soft_block.note: plan soft block A: 60 mm cube, 54 g, centre (0.43,-0.12,h=0.03); the bottom nodes sit at z=0.862 (one particle radius above the table) so the block starts in contact without overlap

width_patches.note: block-local nodes on the -Y and +Y faces with |x| <= 5 mm and |z| <= 5 mm (3 x 3 nodes each, under the pad centres); width = distance between the two patch centroids. Compression = 1 - w / w0, w0 the mean width in measurement.reference_window. Node ids are fixed in inputs/s02_block_mesh.npz

grip.note: closed-loop squeeze: both finger targets move inward at close_speed (per finger) until the filtered width compression reaches target_compression, then freeze; if the finger target reaches finger_min or squeeze_timeout first, the actual compression is kept and reported (no drive or friction compensation)

path.note: one TCP polyline in world frame, parameterised by arc length s: start = grip.tcp; lift +Z by lift_height; straight line to place_xy at the lifted height; lower to grip.tcp z + place_clearance (block bottom about 5 mm above the table if it did not sag); retreat +Z by retreat_height. Top-down orientation throughout. inputs/s02_ik_path.npz tabulates s -> 7 arm joints every ik_step (DexSim IK); each phase moves s between its waypoints with a quintic profile

target_area.note: x 0.50-0.64, y 0.01-0.15; the initial block projection (x 0.40-0.46, y -0.15 to -0.09) does not overlap it

solver.parity_note: all coupling/VBD/MuJoCo options carried over explicitly from S01 (see ../PARITY_CHECKLIST.md)

contact.friction_rule: every shape and particle set uses mu=0.6 (plan default; no finger-pad override in S02: the squeeze needed for 30-40 % width compression gives a normal force far above the 0.53 N weight); all platforms blend particle-shape friction as the average
contact.contact_model: per-vertex particle-shape contact on all platforms (same as S01)

trajectory.controller: closed-loop rule implemented identically in every platform script (class PickPlaceController): settle (reference width); squeeze (closed loop on width); squeeze settle; lift; hold; transport; lower; release; retreat; observe

initial_states.rule: s00 nominal; s01-s09 move the block by dx, dy ~ U(-2, 2) mm and yaw ~ U(-1.5, 1.5) deg about its centre; robot and path unchanged; the file stores the world-space initial node positions (= rest shape)

variants_note: plan 3.3 (5/10/20 substep convergence) and 7.2 (CUDA Graph vs direct paired check); each variant is run on state s00; nominal = 10 substeps with CUDA Graph

outputs: depth (planar distance to the image plane, m)
images.full: every 30 Hz frame: RGB video + depth/segmentation arrays (state s00 runs)
images.keyframes: RGB/depth/segmentation at phase starts and episode end (perturbed states and variants), to bound data volume

measurement.depth_background: no-hit pixels: DexSim/EmbodiChain return a very large value, Isaac Lab returns 0; raw values are stored, plots mask both
measurement.resolution_note: cameras render at 1280x960 for the HD comparison video; depth, segmentation and RGB keyframes are stored at 640x480 (every 2nd pixel) with the matching intrinsics
measurement.video_policy: only one exported video per task: tools/analyze.py writes videos/s02_comparison.mp4 (2x2: columns EmbodiChain / Isaac Lab, rows oblique / front, HD, real-time frame-rate overlay)

acceptance.rules: grasp: compression at squeeze end inside compression_band; lift: lowest node >= lift_min_height above the table during the whole hold; hold: node-centroid z drop over the last hold_drop_window of the hold <= hold_drop_max; transport: lowest node still >= lift_min_height at transport end; place: place_check_delay after the fingers are fully open, node-centroid XY within place_center_error_max of the target centre, >= 95 % of nodes inside the target rectangle and lowest node <= place_rest_height_max above the table (resting); all positions finite. Width recovery error |w_end / w0 - 1| is reported, not gated
